# FINAL PROJECT

## TCGA-BRCA

#### Install Packages:

```{r}
# Explanation: 
# - Import libraries 

library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

#### Load Dataset:

```{r}
# Explanation: 
# - Load data set 
# - Read in count and metadata files using read.csv()
# - Visualize data frames using head 
# - Dimensions 

# Set file path
file_path <- "/Users/akshetavasireddy/documents/"

# Read in files
count_df <- read.csv(paste0(file_path, "counts.csv"), row.names = 1) # Read in count data 
metadata <- read.csv(paste0(file_path,"meta_data.csv"), row.names = 1) # Read in meta data

# Visualize data frames
# head(count_df, 10)
# head(metadata, 10)

# Dimensions of data frames
dim(count_df) # Number of genes 
dim(metadata) # Number of samples 
```

#### Summary Statistics:

```{r}
# Explanation:
# - Get gene data from count matrix (gene: ENSG00000141510.18, TP53 Gene)
# - Generate summary statistics of selected gene 

# Set target gene row
target_gene_1 <- count_df['ENSG00000141510.18',]

# Transpose the data
gene_data_1 <- t(target_gene_1)

## Visualize gene data
head(gene_data_1)

# Get numeric vector 
gene_count_1 <- as.numeric(target_gene_1)

# Generate full summary statistics
summary(gene_count_1, na.rm = TRUE) 
sd(gene_count_1, na.rm = TRUE) # Get standard deviation
```

#### Visualization:

```{r}
# Explanation: 
# - Create histogram 
# - Create scatter plot 
# - Create violin plot 

# Histogram
p1 <- ggplot(gene_data_1, aes(x = gene_count_1)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, 
                   fill = "plum4", 
                   color = "black", 
                   alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Gene Count Distribution: TP53"),
      x = "Gene Count", 
      y = "Number of Samples") +
    theme_minimal()
print(p1)
ggsave("final-project_histogram-plot.png", plot = p1, width = 8, height = 6) # Save plot as .png

# Scatter plot
# Second gene: ENSG00000121879.6, PIK3CA
target_gene_2 <- count_df['ENSG00000121879.6',] # Select second gene
gene_data_2 <- t(target_gene_2) # Transpose second gene data
head(gene_data_2) # Visualize second gene data
gene_count_2 <- as.numeric(target_gene_2) # Get numeric vector of second gene
summary(gene_count_2, na.rm = TRUE) # Generate gene 2 summary statistics

gene_data_df <- merge(gene_data_1, gene_data_2, by = 'row.names', all = TRUE) # Merge columns into single data frame
gene_data_df <- gene_data_df %>% 
  select(-Row.names)
head(gene_data_df)

# Create scatter plot
p2 <- ggplot(gene_data_df, aes(x = gene_count_1, y = gene_count_2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "skyblue2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Scatter Plot: TP53 vs PIK3CA",
    x = "Gene 1: TP53",
    y = "Gene 2: PIK3CA"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p2) # Display scatter plot
ggsave("final-project_scatter-plot.png", plot = p2, width = 8, height = 6) # Save plot as .png

# Violin plot 
metadata_1 <- metadata %>% # Get pathologic stage column from metadata 
  select(paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)

rownames(metadata_1) <- gsub("-", ".", rownames(metadata_1)) # Make format common 

metadata_subtype_df <- merge(gene_data_1, metadata_1, by = "row.names") # Merge columns into a single data frame
metadata_subtype_df <- metadata_subtype_df %>%
  select(-Row.names)
head(metadata_subtype_df)

# Create violin plot (covariate: PAM50 Subtype)
p3 <- ggplot(metadata_subtype_df, aes(x = paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50, y = gene_count_1, fill = paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Basal" = "lightblue", "Her2" = "lightpink", "LumA" = "khaki", "LumB" = "plum", "Normal" = "darkkhaki"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "TP53 Count Data vs PAM50 Subtype", 
       x = "PAM50 Subtype", 
       y = "Gene Count",
       fill = "",
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p3)
ggsave("final-project_violin-plot.png", plot = p3, width = 8, height = 6) # Save plot as .png

# Create cumulative distribution function (cdf)
p4 <- ggplot(gene_data_1, aes(x = gene_count_1)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", color = "darkblue") +
  labs(title = "CDF of TP53 Counts", 
       x = "TP53 Counts", 
       y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p4)
ggsave("final-project_cdf-plot.png", plot = p4, width = 8, height = 6) # Save plot as .png

# Arrange plots into panel
plots <- ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4,
                     ncol = 2,
                     nrow = 2)
print(plots) # Display panel 
ggsave("final-project_gene-plots_panel.png", plot = plots, width = 8, height = 6) # Save panel as .png
```

#### Heatmap Analysis:

```{r}
# Explanation: 
# - Select 10 genes 
# - Generate heat map 
# - Add annotation bar 

# Select 10 genes focusing mostly on those part of the PAM50 subtype
genes_heatmap <- rownames(count_df)[c(1944,  # ESR1
                                      1848,  # BIRC5
                                      2007,  # CDC6
                                      6151,  # FOXA1
                                      16336, # KRT14
                                      9132,  # MKI67
                                      2432,  # MYBL2
                                      5716,  # CD93
                                      2905,  # SFRP1
                                      13101  # CXXC5
)]

head(genes_heatmap, 10)

gene_symbols <- c(ESR1  = 1944, # Assign Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
                  BIRC5 = 1848,
                  CDC6  = 2007,
                  FOXA1 = 6151,
                  KRT14 = 16336,
                  MKI67 = 9132,
                  MYBL2 = 2432,
                  CD93  = 5716,
                  SFRP1 = 2905,
                  CXXC5 = 13101)

# Keep only the 10 genes we want
counts_subset <- count_df[genes_heatmap, ]
counts_matrix <- log2(as.matrix(counts_subset) + 1) # Convert dataset to matrix/log-transform
rownames(counts_matrix) <- names(gene_symbols) # Convert Ensembl IDs to gene symbols 

# Heatmap annotations
column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  "PAM50 Subtype" = metadata$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50,
  col = list(
    "PAM50 Subtype" = c("Basal" = "lightblue", "Her2" = "lightpink", "LumA" = "khaki", "LumB" = "plum", "Normal" = "darkkhaki")
  )
)

# Create heatmap
heatmap_plot <- Heatmap(
  counts_matrix,
  name = "log2(count + 1)",
  top_annotation = column_ha,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  column_title = "Samples",
  row_title = "Genes",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Count\n(log2(Count + 1))")
)

print(heatmap_plot) # Display heatmap 
```

#### Covariate Summary Statistics

```{r}
# Covariate 1 Summary Statistics: PAM50 Subtype
counts_PAM50subtype <- metadata %>% # Count number of each subtype occurrence 
  count(paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50, name = "Count")
print(counts_PAM50subtype) # Print counts 
summary(counts_PAM50subtype, na.rm = TRUE) # Get summary statistics 

# Covariate 2 Summary Statistics: Age
summary(metadata$age_at_index, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(metadata$age_at_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create summary statistics table of covariates 
PAM50_counts.df <- data.frame( # PAM50 Counts
  PAM50_Subtype = c("Basal", "Her2", "LumA", "LumB", "Normal"),
  Counts = c(197, 82, 571, 209, 40)
)
  
covariate_summarystats.df <- data.frame(
  Summary_Stats = c("Min.", "1st Qu.", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu.", "Max."),
  PAM50 = c(40.0, 94.5, 164.5, 205.2, 206.0, 571.0), # PAM50 Stats
  Age = c(26.00, 48.00, 58.00, 58.28, 67.00, 89.00) # Age Stats
)

print(PAM50_counts.df)
print(covariate_summarystats.df)
```
